info.description: REST API for managing WireGuard VPN peers, tunnels, users, groups, and ACLs.
info.title: WireGuard UI API

get.description: Returns all ACL rules.

post.description: Creates a new ACL rule.

get.description: Returns the effective ACL rules for a given user (including group memberships).

post.description: Forces a reload of the ACL policy engine from the database.

get.description: Returns a single ACL rule by ID.

delete.description: Deletes an ACL rule by ID.

get.description: Returns all groups.

post.description: Creates a new group.

get.description: Returns a single group by ID.
Returns the members of a group.
Returns the user's MFA enrollment status and registered credentials.

delete.description: Removes TOTP enrollment for the authenticated user.

post.description: Generates a new TOTP secret for the authenticated user.
Verifies a TOTP code to complete enrollment.
Starts WebAuthn credential registration for the authenticated user.
Completes WebAuthn credential registration.

delete.description: Deletes a WebAuthn credential by ID.

post.description: Allows the authenticated user to change their own password. Revokes all sessions.

get.description: Returns all API tokens for the authenticated user with expiration status.

post.description: Creates a new API token for the authenticated user. The raw token is returned only once.

delete.description: Deletes an API token by ID.

get.description: Returns all peers. Admins see all peers; non-admins see only their own.

post.description: Creates a new WireGuard peer. Auto-allocates IP address.

get.description: Returns a single peer by ID. Ownership enforced for non-admins.

delete.description: Deletes a peer and removes it from the WireGuard interface.

get.description: Returns the WireGuard configuration file for a peer.
Returns a QR code image of the peer's WireGuard configuration.

post.description: Replaces the peer's public key and generates a new preshared key.

get.description: Returns the WireGuard server configuration. Non-admin users get redacted output.

put.description: Updates the WireGuard server configuration. Requires admin role.

post.description: Applies the current server configuration to the WireGuard interface.

get.description: Returns transfer statistics for all peers. Non-admins see only their own peers.
Streams peer transfer statistics via Server-Sent Events.
Returns all tunnels with their runtime status.

post.description: Creates a new WireGuard tunnel.

get.description: Returns a single tunnel by ID.

delete.description: Deletes a tunnel and stops it if running.

get.description: Returns the WireGuard configuration file for the remote side of a tunnel.
Returns the runtime status of a tunnel.
Returns all users.

post.description: Creates a new local user. Requires admin role.

get.description: Returns a single user by ID.

put.description: Updates an existing user. Requires admin role.

delete.description: Deletes a user by ID. Requires admin role. Cannot delete yourself.

put.description: Sets the group memberships for a user.

post.description: Resets a user's password. Requires admin role. Revokes all sessions.

get.description: Handles the OIDC provider callback after authentication.
Returns available authentication methods.
Redirects to OIDC provider if configured, otherwise returns an error indicating local login should be used.

post.description: Authenticates a user with username and password. Returns user info or an MFA challenge if MFA is enabled.
Revokes the session and clears authentication cookies.

get.description: Returns information about the currently authenticated user.

post.description: Verifies a TOTP code during the MFA login step.
Starts a WebAuthn assertion for MFA login.
Completes a WebAuthn assertion for MFA login.
Starts a passwordless WebAuthn (passkey) login flow.
Completes a passwordless WebAuthn (passkey) login flow.
Issues a new short-lived JWT from a valid session cookie.

allow_peer_to_peer.description: when false (default), drops wg→wg traffic to isolate peers

nat_source.description: CIDR for POSTROUTING; defaults to server Address

address.description: VPN address for this end, e.g. "10.100.0.1/30"
VPN address for this end, e.g. "10.100.0.1/30"
VPN address for this end, e.g. "10.100.0.1/30"

ApiKeyAuth.description: Admin API key for machine-to-machine access.
ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key

BearerAuth.description: JWT token or API key. Use "Bearer {token}" format.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
